defs.def: a game played by two teams of 11 players, using a round ball which players kick up and down the playing field. Teams try to kick the ball into the other team's goal. 足球运动

ex.s: 5. — Mike will announce his retirement from professional soccer next week.
ex.t: 5. — 迈克下周将宣布他从职业足球退役。他才25岁，身体仍然很健壮。

ex.s: Even soccer fans tend to have a seat each; gone are the days of thousands standing to watch the match.
ex.t: 所有这些体育场仍然在使用中，仍然开放，仍然承办世界上最大的体育赛事。

ex.s: Then one perfect Amazonian evening, with monkeys calling from beyond the village green, we played soccer.
ex.t: 我们从未感觉如此陌生。

ex.s: I am not good at soccer, but that evening it was wonderful.
ex.t: 我们是在书籍和电脑、高速公路和手机的环境中长大的，但现在我们生活在一个没有自来水和电力的村庄里。一天结束时带着一点被误解的感觉入睡是很容易的。
